body.objective: Add generic exact sparse machinery for completing a partially frozen finite chain complex together with a commuting evolution operator, cyclic/adjoint structure and prescribed homology or SDR target. The first consumer is sf:program/work/classical-berger-q26-104-row-free-adjoint-completion. That work has closed several canonical cone families and is now hand-assembling general non-cone 24/80/80/24 differentials with frozen retained corners, d^2=0, [A,d]=0, adjoint equations, rank targets and a desired (1,1,1,1) cohomology. It has now proved why the constraints must be solved simultaneously: an exact rational non-cone differential is nilpotent with the target cohomology, but a boundary-cokernel covector evaluates to -51/2 on the required A104 image and obstructs every evolution extension of that fixed witness. Current exploration mixes dense SymPy rational elimination, random integer scouts and SciPy LSQR, which is useful for conjecture formation but not an adequate general proof engine.
body.stop_condition: Provide a typed exact API accepting graded dimensions, partial/frozen differential blocks, optional evolution and pairing matrices, linear chain/commutant/adjoint constraints, rank or homology targets, and optional inclusion/projection/homotopy variables. It must: (1) solve the complete linear constraint space sparsely over Q and declared algebraic extensions, with modular/finite-field scouts explicitly typed as scouts; (2) parameterize evolution-invariant projected boundary and cycle subspaces before choosing differential representatives, and emit immediate boundary/cycle cokernel separators when a frozen corner cannot preserve them; (3) decompose by homological normal form and symmetry primary blocks when certified intertwiners are supplied; (4) turn rank and SDR requirements into exact determinantal strata or constructive full-rank witnesses; (5) use rational reconstruction and exact substitution to promote a scout witness; (6) emit either a complete exact construction with d^2, [A,d], adjoint, cohomology and SDR checks, or a declared-class obstruction certificate with a separating cokernel/rank/minor/ideal witness; and (7) provide an independent small checker that does not rerun the search. Demonstrate it on one closed canonical Berger cone fixture, reproduce the exact -51/2 A104 boundary-cokernel obstruction on BERGER_Q26_104_ROW_NONCONE_EVOLUTION_EXTENSION_OBSTRUCTION_V1, and then attack the active simultaneous non-cone 104-row class, with explicit memory/time ceilings and resumable content-addressed intermediate bases.
body.forbid: no floating-point residual called an exact solution; no random search called completeness; no finite-field rank promoted without a characteristic-zero lift or one-sided theorem; no dense materialization when the declared sparse problem exceeds the resource budget; no hidden specialization of couplings or generic pivots; no physics-specific Berger operators embedded in forge/lib/math; no equality of graded dimensions called an SDR; no producer search reused as the independent checker
notes: The generic substrate belongs in forge/lib/math; Berger row orderings and frozen corners remain physics-domain inputs.
The existing Smith, Groebner, FLINT/Arb and exact linear-algebra work should be reused as lower layers.
A useful first slice is exact parameterization of chain maps with fixed corners plus certified rank-stratum witnesses; full cyclic SDR synthesis can follow without weakening the declared final gate.

2026-07-20 acceptance fixture: commit 7e7bdb840 certifies that the serialized rational non-cone differential has the target nilpotence/cohomology but admits no A104 chain endomorphism with the frozen old-old compression. Source e16 maps to old e5; old covector e25* annihilates the projected boundary image but evaluates to -51/2 on A104 e5. The generic solver should discover this separator before allocating the full middle-block solve.
